ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to sparse punctate spots and distal tip clusters, representing less than 5% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous dark-tone field. High-contrast white geometric blobs are absent; instead, an array of isolated, roughly circular high-intensity points (1-5 pixels in diameter) is distributed across both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a wide obtuse angle (~130 degrees) and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by a series of jagged peaks and valleys averaging 3-8 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A continuous concave curve defines the leading edge, while the trailing edges follow a roughly linear trajectory from the median notch to the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups are localized at the distal tips (left and right), consistent with barnacle attachment sites. Smaller, isolated white circular scars are scattered across the central ventral area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible, particularly on the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcification or barnacle colonization is visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, creating a rugged, high-contrast white fringe against the dark fluke body.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of numerous small, bright white focal points scattered stochastically across the dark ventral field, distinct from the larger tip clusters.
